title: UI/UX Designer Intern (Unpaid, Remote)
description:
**Job Opportunity: UI/UX Designer Intern (Unpaid, Remote)**

**About US**

We are seeking proactive and enthusiastic individuals to join our team as
**UI/UX Designer Intern**

at
**Healthletic Lifestyle**

. As a next-generation health, wellness, and fitness start-up, we combine cutting-edge technology with personalized coaching to offer a comprehensive range of online services. 

This internship provides hands-on experience with real-world projects in
**UI/UX Designer**

, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and refine your design skills in a dynamic and supportive environment. All in a remote setting & mobile platform that combines advanced technology with personalized coaching. Our app offers a comprehensive range of online services, including healthy food recommendations, home workout solutions, customized workout plans, nutrition guidance, and wellness insights.

**Details**

Job Type: Internship (Part-time) (Unpaid, Remote)

* Duration: 3 months
* Location: Remote (Work from Home)
* Stipend: Unpaid

**Perks and Benefits**

* Real-World Projects: Contribute to live projects across our platform and partner ventures.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with teams in Frontend, Backend, DevOps, HR, Marketing, and Business Development.
* Corporate Experience: Gain experience in structured roles like Team Leader, Supervisor, and Quality Auditor.
* Mentorship: Receive expert guidance from industry professionals.
* Flexible Schedule: Adjust your schedule to fit academic or personal commitments.
* Skill Development: Enhance your UI/UX, research, and collaboration skills.
* Networking: Build professional connections in the industry.
* Recognition: Receive a certificate of completion and a letter of recommendation for exceptional performance.

**Responsibilities**

* Design user-friendly interfaces for web and mobile applications using tools like Figma.
* Conduct user research through surveys, interviews, and data analysis to enhance user experiences.
* Develop wireframes, prototypes, and visual concepts.
* Collaborate with developers to ensure seamless design-to-code implementation.
* Conduct usability testing and apply feedback for design improvement.
* Maintain UI/UX design documentation and contribute to design guidelines.
* Stay informed on the latest UI/UX design trends and best practices.

**Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing a degree in Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field.
* Proficient in Figma (Experience with Adobe XD or Sketch is a plus).
* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Strong understanding of user-centered design principles.
* Excellent attention to detail, creativity, and design sensibility.
* Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
* Portfolio showcasing UI/UX design projects is preferred.

title: Visual Designer
description:
Namma Yatri is a
**Mobility-as-a-Service (MaaS)**
platform built to empower drivers and provide seamless, frictionless ride experiences for users. We’re not just another ride-hailing app, we’re reimagining urban mobility from the ground up, with drivers at the center and intuitive design as our backbone.

We are looking for a Graphic Designer/Illustrator with a strong grasp of current digital creation tools, visual trends, and an inherent ﬂair for storytelling. You’ll design visuals that have a high impact from product/character illustrations and UI storytelling to marketing creatives and brand expressions.

You’ll collaborate closely with a dynamic cross-functional team including Product Managers, Business Development , UI/UX Designers, Developers as well as folks from Content Marketing, Performance Marketing, Social Media, and Events. Your work will span product launches, campaigns, internal initiatives and user education helping bring ideas to life through compelling visuals.

**Roles and responsibilities:**

●
**Turn Complex Ideas into Visuals:**
Understand how our brand works and create simple, easy-to-understand graphics like infographics, app banners, posters, app illustrations - while meeting deadlines and keeping the quality high.

●
**Design Icons and Illustrations:**
Create original icon sets and illustrations from start to ﬁnish. Come up with ideas, sketch different options, and make sure all visuals match the app or brand’s look and feel while exploring various styles.

●
**Design for the Right Audience:**
Learn deeply about the product and the people using it. Make visuals that grab attention, explain the message clearly and feel relevant to the audience.

●
**Use the Right Tools and Techniques:**
Work with the best-suited design tools and methods for the job. Stay updated on design trends and suggest better ways to work when needed.

**What we are looking for:**

● Experience in creating high-ﬁdelity illustrations.

● Proﬁcient in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and Figma (vector-based tools). Knowledge of Adobe After Effects is a plus.

● Ability to leverage AI tools (such as Chat GPT, Google Gemini, Higgsﬁeld, or Adobe Fireﬂy) to streamline workﬂows, rapidly prototype concepts, and accelerate the creation of high-quality visual assets.

● Comfortable using other Adobe Creative Cloud tools. Familiarity with Procreate is valuable.

● Strong background in digital design. Print design experience is a plus.

● A solid portfolio showcasing creativity and storytelling through illustrations, sketches, infographics and graphic design.

● Creative mindset, takes ownership and has great communication and presentation skills.

title: Digital Products Quality Specialist
description:
The Customer Experience & Quality Specialist supports the continuous improvement of Infineon's developer-facing digital platforms by gathering customer insights, conducting quality assessments, coordinating testing activities, and identifying opportunities to improve user experience.
  
  
Working closing with product Owners and alongside the Operational Excellence Expert, the role serves as the customer advocate within the product team, ensuring customer feedback, usability findings, and quality insights are systematically collected, analyzed, and converted into meaningful product enhancements.
  
  
Your role
  
  
Key responsibilities in your new role
  
  
**1**
**Customer Feedback Management**

* Monitor customer feedback channels, surveys, and support insights.
* Support the closed-loop feedback process by categorizing, tracking, and following up on customer issues.
* Identify recurring themes, trends, and root causes from customer feedback.
* Escalate customer-impacting issues to Product Owners and the Operational Excellence Expert for resolution and tracking.
* Assist in preparing regular customer experience reviews and reports.

**2**
**User Research & Customer Insights**

* Conduct customer interviews and collect qualitative feedback.
* Support the development of interview guides and research plans.
* Analyze user behavior, pain points, and unmet needs across the developer journey.
* Summarize findings and propose improvement opportunities for products, content, and user journeys.
* Help maintain a continuous feedback loop between users and product teams.

**3**
**Product Quality Validation**

* Execute regression testing for key user journeys and platform features.
* Validate new functionality before release from a customer experience perspective.
* Document defects, usability challenges, and improvement recommendations.
* Coordinate with Product Owners and Engineering teams to verify issue resolution.
* Help maintain testing documentation and quality checklists.

**4**
**Break-a-thons & User Testing**

* Support the planning and execution of break-a-thons and user testing initiatives.
* Create testing scenarios covering critical user journeys and edge cases.
* Coordinate participation across business functions and regions.
* Capture findings, prioritize observations, and ensure outcomes are documented.
* Track implementation of identified improvements.

**5**
**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to enhance usability, content discoverability, accessibility, and customer satisfaction.
* Support root cause analysis activities for recurring customer issues.
* Work with Product Owners and the Operational Excellence Expert to ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Track the effectiveness of improvement initiatives and report outcomes.

**6**
**Collaboration with Operational Excellence**
The role works closely with the Operational Excellence Expert, who owns:
  
  

* Operational processes and governance
* Platform monitoring and observability
* Dashboarding and reporting infrastructure
* Workflow automation
* SLA management
* Incident management and operational escalation

The Customer Experience & Quality Specialist contributes by:
  
  

* Providing customer insights that help prioritize operational improvements.
* Identifying quality gaps and customer-impacting issues.
* Validating whether operational fixes solve underlying customer problems.
* Supporting root cause investigations from a customer perspective.
* Measuring customer impact after improvements are implemented.

Your profile
  
  
**Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, UX, Digital Products, Information Systems, or similar.
* 2-3 years of experience in Customer Experience, Product Quality, UX Research, Digital Marketing, Product Operations, or a related field.
* Experience analyzing customer feedback and user behavior
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Familiarity with digital platforms, websites, or customer-facing products

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
  
  
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
  
  
Are you in?
  
  
We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.
  
  
We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity.
  
  
Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

title: Product Localisation Lead - India
description:
**Job Description**
**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte, namaste!
  
  
Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
  
  
**Where And How You Can Work**
Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role, we’re focusing on Bangalore so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.
  
  
**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**

* Own Canva’s product and localisation strategy for India, with a strong focus on user growth and experience across languages.
* Contribute to the product roadmap for India, including features, payment methods, authentication flows, and other market-specific initiatives.
* Analyse the active user and subscription funnels to identify opportunities for improving activation, engagement, and conversion.
* Evaluate and adapt global messaging, campaigns, and product experiences to resonate with Indian users across different regions and languages.
* Provide cultural and linguistic insights to global teams to inform product, content, and marketing decisions.
* Project management to drive cross-functional collaboration on localisation: Marketing, Content, SEO and Product
* Manage relationships with external localisation partners and collaborate with external linguists, translators and the in-house Language Manager, to ensure clarity, cultural nuance, and consistency across all Indian-language experiences. Together, develop and evolve style guides, tone of voice principles, and best practices for the region.
* Help prioritise localisation investments across languages and regions based on impact, scale, and user needs.

**Qualifications**
What we're looking for
  
  

* 5+ years of experience working in product, growth, or localisation roles within a high-growth SaaS or product-led company.
* Strong product and growth mindset, with an understanding of how India’s language ecosystem (including regional languages and English usage patterns) influences user behaviour and product adoption.
* Strong understanding of content and UX copy, including the ability to write and adapt English-language messaging for Indian users across product and growth surfaces.
* Experience working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders across product, marketing, content, and regional teams.
* Fluency in English, with strong proficiency in at least one major Indian language. Familiarity with multiple Indian languages is a strong plus.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and scaling solutions in complex, multi-market environments.
* A strategic thinker who is equally happy rolling up their sleeves and executing.
* Genuine passion for Canva’s mission to empower the world to design.

**Additional Information**
**About the Group/Team**
Canva’s International Supergroup is responsible for driving growth and deepening adoption across our key regions worldwide. We are an entrepreneurial, cross-functional team that turns bold strategy into culturally resonant execution.
  
  
In India, our mission is to empower people across the country to design and express themselves, regardless of language, geography, or background. India represents one of Canva’s most important growth opportunities, with a deeply diverse language ecosystem, a rapidly expanding creator economy, and millions of users coming online for the first time. Our goal is to make Canva feel intuitive, accessible, and truly local for users across India.
  
  
**About The Role/Specialty**
As the India Localisation Lead, you will own Canva’s product and localisation experience in India, ensuring users across different regions and languages have the best possible Canva experience. You will be the voice of Indian users and a champion for culturally and linguistically relevant product experiences.
  
  
This role goes beyond translation. It requires a strong understanding of India’s language landscape, how users switch between languages, and how localisation decisions impact trust, usability, and growth at scale.

title: Volunteer
description:
**Company Description**
quipe is building a “singularity app” that brings many websites and applications together into a single, unified platform. The goal is to offer all types of services in one place, reducing the need for multiple apps, accounts, and browser tabs. By simplifying navigation and minimizing user interface fatigue, quipe aims to create a more seamless and efficient digital experience. Curious users and partners are encouraged to learn more and ask questions through quipe.ai, reflecting the company’s open and exploratory culture.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time remote Volunteer role focused on supporting the development, improvement, and outreach of the quipe platform. Day-to-day tasks may include researching and documenting user needs, testing new features, and providing clear feedback to help refine the user experience. Volunteers may assist with content creation, organizing information about services offered in the platform, and responding to user questions or community inquiries. The role can also involve collaborating with the team on simple operational tasks, helping coordinate online activities, and sharing ideas to enhance accessibility and usability. All work is performed remotely, with flexible collaboration across time zones and communication channels.

**Qualifications**

* Ability to conduct basic online research, organize information clearly, and summarize findings for the team.
* Strong written communication skills for drafting short explanations, user guides, or updates about platform features.
* Comfort with using web and mobile applications, navigating digital tools, and testing new interfaces.
* Collaborative mindset, reliability in meeting agreed commitments, and openness to feedback in a remote environment.
* Interest in product design, user experience, or digital platforms; prior experience in these areas is helpful but not required.
* Self-motivation, attention to detail, and willingness to learn new tools and processes.
* Access to a reliable internet connection and a suitable device for remote work.

title: Engineer III Software
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
  
  
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
  
  
DESCRIPTION:
  
  
Join Thermo Fisher Scientific, the world leader in serving science, as a Staff Engineer, Software to make a meaningful impact. In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural guidance while developing innovative software solutions that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Working in a supportive, multi-functional environment, you will design and implement sophisticated solutions across our product portfolio, from cloud platforms to scientific instrumentation. You will support the growth of other engineers, drive adoption of best practices, and help shape the technical direction of critical projects. This position offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies while contributing to groundbreaking scientific discoveries.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a highly experienced
**Senior UI Engineer**
with 6+ years of software development experience and strong expertise in building scalable, high-performance, and responsive web applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have deep hands-on experience with
**Angular, React, TypeScript, eCharts, frontend integration, and responsive UI development**
. The candidate will be responsible for defining frontend architecture, developing complex user interfaces, integrating frontend applications with backend services, and providing technical leadership to development teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop scalable, maintainable, and high-performance frontend applications using Angular and React.
* Define and drive the frontend architecture, design patterns, coding standards, and engineering best practices.
* Develop reusable UI components, shared libraries, and frontend frameworks to improve development efficiency and consistency.
* Build rich, interactive, and data-driven visualizations using eCharts.
* Develop dashboards, charts, graphs, and other visualization components for complex datasets.
* Design and implement responsive user interfaces supporting multiple screen resolutions, browsers, and devices.
* Develop applications using TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend systems through REST APIs, Web APIs, WebSockets, or other integration mechanisms.
* Collaborate closely with backend developers, UX/UI designers, product owners, architects, and other stakeholders.
* Optimize frontend applications for performance, scalability, maintainability, and usability.
* Identify and resolve complex UI, browser compatibility, integration, and performance issues.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards and secure coding practices.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to frontend developers.
* Evaluate new frontend technologies, frameworks, and libraries and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Participate in technical design discussions, architecture reviews, estimation, and implementation planning.
* Drive improvements in frontend development practices, automated testing, build pipelines, and deployment processes.

**Required Technical Skills**

* 6-10 years of overall software development experience, with significant experience in frontend application development.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Angular and its ecosystem.
* Strong hands-on experience with React and component-based application development.
* Advanced proficiency in TypeScript and JavaScript.
* Strong experience with eCharts or similar data visualization/charting frameworks.
* Experience developing complex data visualization dashboards and interactive charts.
* Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, SCSS/SASS, Flexbox, and CSS Grid.
* Strong experience in responsive and adaptive UI development.
* Strong understanding of frontend architecture and modern design patterns.
* Experience integrating frontend applications with RESTful APIs and backend services.
* Good understanding of asynchronous programming, API error handling, state management, and frontend data flow.
* Experience with frontend performance optimization, lazy loading, caching, and bundle optimization.
* Familiarity with unit testing and frontend testing frameworks.
* Experience with source control systems such as Git.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and modern software development practices.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to translate business and user requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Strong ownership and accountability for technical deliverables.
* Ability to lead technical discussions and influence architectural decisions.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
* Strong mentoring and coaching capabilities.
* Passion for building intuitive, performant, and high-quality user experiences.

**Education**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in
**Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline**
.

title: Senior UX | Product Designer | Consumer Commerce at 200M+ User scale
description:
Our client is building a new way for people to discover and shop, one that is personal, visual and inspiration-led rather than search-led. Rooted in fashion and expanding into wider lifestyle journeys, the work sits where systems thinking, premium aesthetics and massive engineering scale meet.

The platform is natively integrated into the mobile ecosystem and reaches hundreds of millions of users. Your design decisions will shape one of the most frequently used digital experiences in the country.

**Who Will Do Well**

A mature designer who brings structural clarity to ambiguity and strong craft to complexity. You move comfortably from framing user problems to high-fidelity execution, think in scalable systems, and raise the quality of every product conversation you join.

**What You Will Do**

* **Own core commerce journeys:**
  Act as design owner for end-to-end commerce and discovery experiences. Identify the right problems to solve and turn complex machine-learning capabilities into interfaces that feel simple and natural.
* **Stay hands-on, think in systems:**
  Work across user flows, interaction frameworks, layouts and high-fidelity prototypes, while keeping an eye on scalability and a high bar for craft.
* **Influence across functions:**
  Partner as a peer with Product, Engineering, Data and Research to balance user intuition with business goals.
* **Build and mentor:**
  Set up design frameworks and processes, and lead a team of mid-level and junior interaction and visual designers.
* **Be a design champion:**
  Advocate user-centred design across the wider organisation and represent the team's innovations at design forums and industry conferences.

**What You Bring**

* A portfolio of shipped, complex consumer-facing work that is live in the market at scale, showing strong product thinking and refined interaction design
* Deep command of information architecture, interface hierarchy, cognitive load management and multi-state system flows
* Strong understanding of Android design paradigms and mobile-first ecosystems
* Excellent communication, storytelling and presentation skills, including the ability to align senior stakeholders on design strategy

**Good to Have**

* Experience designing consumer products driven by personalisation, recommendation feeds or rich-media discovery that impact retention and conversion
* Experience in high-velocity, high-ambiguity environments where you set design guidelines or mentored junior designers
* Bachelor's, Master's or Post-Graduate degree in Interaction Design, HCI, Product Design, Information Design or Visual Communication

**Why This Role**

* Design for a user base at true internet scale
* Work on AI-driven personalisation and next-generation commerce experiences
* Real ownership, a leadership mandate and a platform to build your external profile

**Location:**
Bangalore, India

Please write to amit.n@careerxperts.com to get connected!

title: Sr. Product Design Manager – HRIS | India Design Site Lead
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
At Rippling, Design is central to our mission to free smart people to tackle hard problems. We build products that automate the operational complexity of running a business—from HR and payroll to IT and finance—so our customers can focus on what matters most. In a world of fragmented, outdated systems, we’re creating a modern, unified platform where thoughtful design turns complexity into clarity and confidence.
  
  
As the Senior Product Design Manager for HRIS and India Site Lead, you will lead a team of ~6 designers responsible for Rippling's HCM and HRIS products, while serving as the site lead for the broader India design organization, supporting an additional ~5 designers across Payroll, Finance, and Platform. You'll play a key role in growing design talent, strengthening team culture, and partnering with cross-functional leaders to raise the quality and impact of the organization.
  
  
Your team owns products at the heart of how companies manage their workforce, from core employee records to onboarding, compliance, and global workforce operations. You'll lead the evolution of these experiences while helping define Rippling's AI-first future, designing intelligent workflows and agentic experiences that automate HR work at scale.
  
  
Success in this role requires a leader who can navigate highly complex product domains, think in systems, and balance long-term platform strategy with exceptional product execution. You'll empower your team to solve challenging customer problems, raise the bar for design craft, and shape experiences that millions of employees and HR administrators rely on every day.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead and grow a team of product designers across the HCM product suite, driving high-impact work across HR, Talent, Benefits, and Workforce Management.
* Design and deliver complex, business-critical experiences that are intuitive, scalable, and trustworthy across global and regulatory contexts.
* Define and drive AI-native experiences that radically simplify administrator and employee workflows—leveraging automation, intelligent defaults, and agentic systems to reduce operational overhead.
* Set a high bar for craft, quality, and execution—mentoring designers, providing actionable feedback, and creating an environment where designers do the best work of their careers.
* Drive end-to-end product thinking—from early problem definition and research through execution and iteration—across both 0→1 initiatives and mature product areas.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders to define product strategy, prioritize initiatives, and deliver against ambitious roadmaps.
* Establish and reinforce systems thinking across the team—creating patterns and frameworks that scale across products and ensure consistency across Rippling’s platform.
* Translate complex operational, compliance, and workforce challenges into simple, elegant user experiences for both administrators and employees.
* Champion a deep understanding of customers, especially in high-complexity domains like global HR, compliance, and hourly workforce management.
* Contribute to and evolve Rippling’s design system, ensuring consistency and quality across surfaces while enabling teams to move quickly.
* Drive alignment across teams working on interdependent systems, ensuring cohesive experiences across HRIS, Time, and the broader Rippling platform.
* Serve as the India Site Lead for Design, fostering a vibrant local office culture, driving team collaboration, and providing site-wide operational leadership.

**What You Will Need**

* 10+ years of professional product design experience, with 5+ years leading and managing design teams.
* Proven track record of delivering high-impact, customer-facing products in complex domains such as HCM/HRIS, fintech, enterprise software, or workforce management.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and large problem spaces, turning complex systems into intuitive, user-friendly experiences.
* Strong systems thinking, with experience designing across interconnected products or platforms and creating scalable patterns and frameworks.
* Experience defining and shipping AI-native or automation-driven product experiences, including intelligent workflows, decision support, or agentic systems that reduce user effort.
* Experience owning and delivering end-to-end product design—from strategy and roadmap definition through execution and QA.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and grow designers across different levels of experience, raising the overall quality bar of the team.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional partners and drive alignment across teams.
* Strong product sense and judgment, with the ability to balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints.

title: Front End Engineer
description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.
  
  
We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.
  
  
**Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security?**
Cohesity is looking for a Front End Software Engineer to join one of our largest teams in Cloud Vertical. With millions of documents, terabytes of emails, and endless Teams conversations, we deal with unprecedented data volumes that require unique strategies and algorithms to process data efficiently. Keeping pace with the changing nature of products while ensuring seamless protection is a puzzle we solve every day. Our team tackles these challenges head-on with creativity, technical expertise, and a passion for excellence. Through mentorship, cross-training, and constant learning, you’ll grow your skills in ways you never imagined. Be part of a mission-critical team to protect the data that drives businesses across the world.
  
  
As a Front End Software Engineer, you will be an individual contributor focused on delivering features with high quality, along with continuous quality improvements with the help of automation. Working on the UI, you’ll be expected to coordinate with Product Management and User Experience team on the mock-ups as well as with the backend engineers on the interfaces and end-to-end testing. There will be a large variety of features to work on including: distributed and parallel data flows, cloud services, asynchronous programming, performance optimization, infinite scalability, snapshots, resiliency, multiple protocols, and fault tolerance.
  
  
We are a passionate team of customer obsessed and quality focused engineers with a desire to disrupt the way organizations manage and protect their data, to help them unleash the maximum value locked in their data. We are looking for an outstanding UI Engineer to expand our team of UI engineers that are excited about building quality products and delivering value to customers through simplifying the world of data management.
  
  
**How You’ll Spend Your Time Here**
As part of this team, you will design and build massively distributed systems at web-scale. You’ll be building the UI that is closest to the customers when they are interacting with Cohesity’s hyper-converged, highly-scalable storage clusters.
  
  
**WE’D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING**

* 2+ years of developing and troubleshooting UI in large scale distributed systems
* BE/BTech degree in Computer Science with proficiency in data structures, algorithms, and software design. Master’s degree would be a plus.
* Strong understanding of UX and UI design principles
* Expertise in HTML, CSS and JavaScript

* Having worked on and understanding of large-scale engineering challenges and highly available distributed systems
* In-depth understanding of the entire web development process – design, development, and deployment
* Proficient understanding of cross-browser compatibility issues and ways to work around them
* Excellent analytical and multi-tasking skills
* Excellent written and spoken communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support decision making.

Working in a supportive, multi-functional environment, you will design and implement sophisticated solutions across our product portfolio, from cloud platforms to scientific instrumentation. You will support the growth of other engineers, drive adoption of best practices, and help shape the technical direction of critical projects. We are looking for a highly experienced **Senior UI Engineer** with 6+ years of software development experience and strong expertise in building scalable, high-performance, and responsive web applications.

The ideal candidate should have deep hands-on experience with **Angular, React, TypeScript, eCharts, frontend integration, and responsive UI development**. * Develop dashboards, charts, graphs, and other visualization components for complex datasets.
* Design and implement **responsive user interfaces** supporting multiple screen resolutions, browsers, and devices.
* Develop applications using **TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3**.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend systems through **REST APIs, Web APIs, WebSockets, or other integration mechanisms**.
* Collaborate closely with backend developers, UX/UI designers, product owners, architects, and other stakeholders.
* Optimize frontend applications for **performance, scalability, maintainability, and usability**.
* Identify and resolve complex UI, browser compatibility, integration, and performance issues.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards and secure coding practices.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to frontend developers.
* Evaluate new frontend technologies, frameworks, and libraries and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Participate in technical design discussions, architecture reviews, estimation, and implementation planning.

**Required Technical Skills**

* **6-10 years of overall software development experience**, with significant experience in frontend application development.

* Strong hands-on experience with **React** and component-based application development.
* Advanced proficiency in **TypeScript and JavaScript**.
* Strong experience with **eCharts** or similar data visualization/charting frameworks.
* Experience developing complex **data visualization dashboards and interactive charts**.
* Strong knowledge of **HTML5, CSS3, SCSS/SASS, Flexbox, and CSS Grid**.
* Strong experience in **responsive and adaptive UI development**.
* Strong understanding of frontend architecture and modern design patterns.
* Experience integrating frontend applications with **RESTful APIs and backend services**.
* Good understanding of asynchronous programming, API error handling, state management, and frontend data flow.
* Experience with frontend performance optimization, lazy loading, caching, and bundle optimization.
* Familiarity with unit testing and frontend testing frameworks.
* Experience with source control systems such as **Git**.
* Understanding of **CI/CD pipelines and modern software development practices**.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to translate business and user requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Strong ownership and accountability for technical deliverables.
* Ability to lead technical discussions and influence architectural decisions.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
* Strong mentoring and coaching capabilities.
* Passion for building intuitive, performant, and high-quality user experiences.

**Education**

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline**.

**Whats in it for you?**  

At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you.

As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day.

Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.

Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles - simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable.

**Salary** - Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment.

**Performance Bonus** - Opportunity to earn additional compensation bonus based on performance, paid annually

**Leave & Time-off** - Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy.

**Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary** - In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF.

**Health is Wealth** - Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws.

**Mental Wellbeing** - We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.

**Financial Wellbeing** - Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.

**Save As You Earn (SAYE)** - Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3-year savings plan.

**Physical Wellbeing** - Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle.

**About Us**  

At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve.

At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed.

We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.

When you join Tesco Bengaluru in this role, you'll be employed by Tesco Bengaluru Private Limited, the Tesco legal entity responsible for your employment.
